caption: Aortic valve, normal and mild and severe aortic stenosis (columns): LV pressure (black), aortic-trunk pressure AoT (grey), the transvalvular pressure difference dp and the effective area A_eff. Each column digitised every 0.005 s from 0 to 0.80 s into mynard2012_fig4_<case>_pressures.csv (dp = LV - AoT) and mynard2012_fig4_<case>_A_eff.csv. Time from the 0.2 s scale bar (742.5 px/s); t = 0 at each column's left edge; a column is 0.80 s of the 0.89 s beat (Table I: T = 0.89 s), the last 0.09 s of diastole not shown (t = 0 matches Fig. 5's time origin: the opening instants agree within 0.005 s). Pressure axes from the ticks 0-150 mmHg, dp from 0-100 mmHg, A_eff from 0-6 cm2 and the baseline. Where the grey AoT line is hidden under LV during ejection, AoT = LV - dp(panel). normal: LV peak 113.2 mmHg at 0.340 s, AoT 70.9-113.5 mmHg, peak dp 7.7 mmHg at 0.145 s (text: 8.3), A_eff max 6.78 cm2, LV rises above AoT at 0.140 s, A_eff > 0.03 cm2 from 0.135 to 0.490 s; mild stenosis: LV peak 111.9 mmHg at 0.295 s, AoT 61.8-111.0 mmHg, peak dp 22.4 mmHg at 0.150 s (text: 23), A_eff max 3.26 cm2, LV rises above AoT at 0.130 s, A_eff > 0.03 cm2 from 0.130 to 0.550 s; severe stenosis: LV peak 171.8 mmHg at 0.305 s, AoT 58.6-99.3 mmHg, peak dp 94.4 mmHg at 0.255 s (text: 95), A_eff max 0.68 cm2, LV rises above AoT at 0.130 s, A_eff > 0.03 cm2 from 0.145 to 0.665 s. The digitised dp peaks sit 0.3-0.6 mmHg below the values in the text (line centre of a 5 px line; the normal peak is a narrow spike).

Aortic valve state zeta for the normal valve (black), mild (blue) and severe (red) stenosis, digitised every 0.005 s from 0 to 1.0 s into mynard2012_fig5_<case>_zeta.csv (axes from the ticks: 0-1 s, zeta 0-1). Its time origin is the same as Fig. 4's column edges (A_eff/A_eff,max of Fig. 4 lies on zeta). Stretches hidden under a later-drawn curve are interpolated, or zero on the baseline. normal: zeta > 0.02 from 0.140 to 0.485 s, zeta = 0.5 at 0.145 s (opening) and 0.455 s (closing), max 1.00; mild stenosis: zeta > 0.02 from 0.130 to 0.545 s, zeta = 0.5 at 0.160 s (opening) and 0.505 s (closing), max 0.96; severe stenosis: zeta > 0.02 from 0.135 to 0.715 s, zeta = 0.5 at 0.185 s (opening) and 0.545 s (closing), max 1.00.
